subject.title: fix(msteams): add timeouts to file consent upload requests

question: Should this PR's size-aware upload resolver become the canonical Microsoft Teams upload-timeout policy, with https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/104288 revised to reuse it?
rationale: Both open branches modify the same owner module but choose materially different compatibility behavior for slow large uploads; selecting and coordinating that runtime policy requires Microsoft Teams area-owner intent.

options.title: Canonicalize size-aware policy
options.body: Approve this shared helper and transfer-budget resolver, then update the sibling PR's content upload to pass its buffer size while retaining 30-second control-plane deadlines.

options.title: Accept fixed five-minute ceiling
options.body: Prefer the sibling's fixed upload timeout and explicitly accept that sufficiently slow valid large transfers may be aborted.

options.title: Pause for timeout calibration
options.body: Hold both PRs until an area owner selects a different transfer-rate floor from production or Microsoft-service evidence.

recommendation.title: Canonicalize size-aware policy
recommendation.body: Approve this shared helper and transfer-budget resolver, then update the sibling PR's content upload to pass its buffer size while retaining 30-second control-plane deadlines.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent path history shows the strongest repeated ownership of Plugin SDK and runtime-helper boundaries in the consent-upload module.
